notes: TBox delete of a rule that also follows from a wider rule (firm, 'anchored by countless instances') and the class's link to it; the record's worlds all cut the link, so it is the top-level gives_up. A member stored whole keeps its form (stores); one built from the rule loses it. The four derived queries ask which verb form the subject takes: a find through the functional takes_verb_form (the sentence choices are surfaces of the singular and plural verb individuals); the prompts' new subjects are given as members of the edited class. Relabelled dl on 2026-10-31 (COVERAGE.md label corrections: choosing the sentence is choosing the subject's one number value, no comparison beyond that); the fol section keeps its Z3 encoding as a second check. Premises (2026-10-31): the class link and the wider rule entail the deleted rule, so the pre-edit route through them is the same route as the deleted rule (justify.py: via_premises), not an edit-free one.

fol.notes: Agreement as the subject's grammatical_number (enum Number): the sentence choice is a find on it, each candidate sentence a surface of its number in 'choices'. The rule over the class is a finite quantifier over the record's subjects. Fact ids follow the DL file. Delete: the class link to the wider rule is cut in every world (top-level gives_up), as in the DL file; a phrase stored whole keeps its form through stores.
